## Monday, 2026-08-03 | ERCOT BESS Fleet (32 Nodes)

---

## 1. PERFORMANCE SUMMARY

Yesterday's fleet average RT settled at **$36.98/MWh**, up sharply from $34.78 on 08-01 and continuing a three-day ascending trend from $24.87 on 07-30 — a **+49% run-up in four days** that reflects tightening summer heat load across ERCOT. Twelve nodes cleared above **$100/MWh** in RT, led by a fleet peak of **$117.36/MWh**, with the spike cluster concentrated at West Texas and Permian Basin nodes (TOYAH_RN, SADLBACK_RN, FAULKNER_RN, COYOTSPR_RN, LONESTAR_RN, RTLSNAKE_BT, CEDRVALE_RN, SBEAN_BESS, GOMZ_RN, GRDNE_ESR_RN, JDKNS_RN, SANDLAKE_RN). The bottom-five DART nodes (GRDNE_ESR_RN at $2.94 through RTLSNAKE_BT at $3.97) all posted RT exceeding DA by only a modest margin, meaning RT dispatch at these spike nodes still captured triple-digit RT prices with minimal DA premium sacrifice.
